definitions.gloss: epidermis; the outermost layer of skin
definitions.explanation: the thin outer layer of skin that protects the body

notes:
SKIN LAYERS:
- {表皮|ひょうひ} - epidermis (outermost layer)
- {真皮|しんぴ} - dermis (middle layer)
- ⟦{皮下|ひか}→皮下：08743_hika⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧ - subcutaneous tissue (innermost layer)

MEDICAL/SCIENTIFIC CONTEXT:
{表皮|ひょうひ} is the technical term used in medical and scientific contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (skin) is more commonly used.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧ - skin (general medical term)
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ - skin (everyday word, often refers to complexion)
